violations.text: Hot dogs and cheese were observed held at 45 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Hot dogs and cheese were observed in the front of unit. Food temperatures rose from opening and closing unit. Ambient of refrigerator was observed at 41 DF. Food items were placed in the back of unit. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

Milk and whipped cream was observed held at 50 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC voluntarily disposed of food. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/28/2024

A small table top refrigeration unit was observed in poor repair (not holding adequate ambient temperature). PIC too unit out of service at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/28/2024
